Messages.Body:
Just checking, does Fear of Mekhet affect Sabbat Cardinals and Pricus?
Also, is there a restriction on how many Pricus or Cardinals one Sabbat
Clan my have?
If there are two Cardinals of the same clan out, are they contested?
Finally, Is a Wild Hunt considered the same as a Blood Hunt for ruling
purposes?
For example, may not call a blood hunt on Vampire A, can a wild hunt be
called on this Vampire?

Messages.Author: Dave Green
Messages.Body:
faust (fa...@post1.com) wrote:
: Just checking, does Fear of Mekhet affect Sabbat Cardinals and Pricus?

: Also, is there a restriction on how many Pricus or Cardinals one Sabbat
: Clan my have?

No and no

: If there are two Cardinals of the same clan out, are they contested?

No

: Finally, Is a Wild Hunt considered the same as a Blood Hunt for ruling
: purposes?

yes, for all purposes, really. I don't yet understand why the
distinction was made, as they are just different names for
exactly the same thing in V:tES game play (I understand that
there is a distinction somewhere in the RPG, but that has never
been much of a concern before, so why now?

: For example, may not call a blood hunt on Vampire A, can a wild hunt be
: called on this Vampire?

If you mean things like Archon or Muaziz, then no, a wild hunt
may not be called. An interesting twist, though, the Bloodhunt
card from the original set (cannot be placed on a prince or
justicar) can be played on titled Sabbat vampires, and other
Sabbat vampires can take advantage of it. Kinda wierd, I
think, but reasonable from a game standpoint, I guess.

-Dave Green

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
faust wrote:
>
> Just checking, does Fear of Mekhet affect Sabbat Cardinals and Pricus?

No. card text: "Put this card on a ready Justicar or Inner Circle member" -
Sabbat Cardinals and Prisci members are neither.

> Also, is there a restriction on how many Pricus or Cardinals one Sabbat
> Clan my have?

No.

> If there are two Cardinals of the same clan out, are they contested?

No.

> Finally, Is a Wild Hunt considered the same as a Blood Hunt for ruling
> purposes?

Yes. They are the same thing for all purposes.

> For example, may not call a blood hunt on Vampire A, can a wild hunt be
> called on this Vampire?

No.

Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
faust wrote:
>
> Just checking, does Fear of Mekhet affect Sabbat Cardinals and Pricus?

Nope. It is an Anti-Camarilla-only card.

> Also, is there a restriction on how many Pricus or Cardinals one Sabbat
> Clan my have?

Nope. The rules doesn't restrict you in the total number of titled
minions. (Think the Caitiff / Pander Weeny political deck... How many
titles may CLANLESS vamps have? All they can seize... :)

> If there are two Cardinals of the same clan out, are they contested?

Nope. Cardinal is not clan-specific (at least to my knowledge)

> Finally, Is a Wild Hunt considered the same as a Blood Hunt for ruling
> purposes?

Yep. The terms are interchangeble.

> For example, may not call a blood hunt on Vampire A, can a wild hunt be
> called on this Vampire?
>

You think of Muaziz, do you? Sorry, no. You cannot call a wild hunt on
someone on whoom you may not call a blood hunt.
